areas.name: Gamla byn vid kyrkan
areas.note: Street View May 2024 (Pilgatan, Kyrkvägen, Stiftsgården): the old village around the church is falu-red timber farmsteads with white trim and red tile roofs; specific entries win

areas.name: Villaområdet Ängsås/Skommars/Furutorp
areas.note: Street View May 2024 (Ängsås väg, Skommars väg, Furutorpsvägen): 1950s–70s villas, 1–1½ storeys; red brick, white/brown/falu/yellow boards; dark concrete or red tile roofs; round 5 (Skommars väg, Ängsås väg, Prästskogsgatan, Libergs väg, Backavägen): nearly all one-storey bungalows — red or cream brick, dark brown or white boards, black/dark tile roofs

areas.name: Östra stan (Knihsgatan/Dalagatan/Parkgatan)
areas.note: Street View May 2024 (Knihsgatan, Dalagatan, Parkgatan): older timber villas (falu red, white, yellow, grey-green), some rendered with mansard roofs, garages; round 5 (Skolgatan, Dalagatan, Knihsgatan): almost all falu red 1940s two-storey timber apartment houses with white external stairs/galleries and brown-red tile roofs

areas.name: Södra sluttningen (Hvilan/Kvarngatan/Slalomvägen)
areas.note: Street View May 2024 (Hvilan, Kvarngatan, Slalomvägen): timber houses on the slope towards Siljan, falu red and white, red tile roofs; round 5 (Hvilan, Perjonsgatan): falu red two-storey apartment houses with white stairs and galleries dominate

areas.name: Industriområdet Hälleberg
areas.note: Street View May 2024 (Hällebergs väg, Filarvägen, Gjutarvägen, Reparatörvägen): low white, cream and grey halls, red-brick and ochre workshops, metal roofs

areas.name: Nyåker villas (Envägen/Alvägen)
areas.note: Street View May 2024 (Envägen, Alvägen): 1970s one-storey villas in dark brown stained boards with black/dark brown tile roofs, white garage doors; wins over the industrial area
